data.summary: Musterbank eG informs Sam Rivera that the monthly account fee for the Girokonto Klassik will rise from €4.90 to €6.90 as of 01.12.2026, and asks for explicit consent (Zustimmung) by 30.11.2026, following a BGH ruling that silence no longer counts as agreement.
data.explanation: Your bank wants to raise the monthly fee for your current account. Because of a court ruling, banks can no longer assume you agree just because you stay silent — you must actively say yes, either online under "Postfach › Zustimmungen" or by returning the signed reply form. Give your consent by the deadline shown in the letter if you want to keep the account on these new terms. If you do nothing, the bank says it may end this account relationship with two months' notice; you may also cancel the account yourself free of charge at any time. If you are a student or trainee under 27, ask about the fee-free "Start" account model instead.
